name: Talking About Your Job
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on talking about your job — practice these key phrases out loud:
What do you do exactly at your company?
I'm mainly responsible for managing our client accounts.
It can get pretty busy during quarter-end.
I've been in this role for about three years now.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
